description.html: This glass terrarium (100x50x50 cm, 250 L) comes with exterior decorative film in a pattern of your choice. The glass gives a clear view of the inside, while film on three sides gives the animals a sense of security.

A length of 100 cm and a width of 50 cm provide a large floor area for ground-dwelling species. The ample length allows a temperature gradient from a warm to a cool zone, which every reptile needs to stay healthy. The ventilation system is designed for constant airflow that prevents overheating and trapped moisture.

Every terrarium we make is handmade, so you can choose the dimensions, film color, ventilation type and 3D background style. We also build fully custom models to your needs, so contact us for a consultation. Delivery throughout Serbia.
